findings.title: XSS vulnerability in search input
findings.description: User input is reflected in the page without sanitization, allowing cross-site scripting attacks.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize and encode all user input before rendering. Implement Content Security Policy headers.

findings.title: Mixed content (HTTP resources on HTTPS page)
findings.description: Page loads 3 scripts and 2 stylesheets over plain HTTP while the page itself is served over HTTPS.
findings.recommendation: Update all resource URLs to use HTTPS. Use protocol-relative URLs or explicit HTTPS.

findings.title: Missing alt text on images
findings.description: 15 images across the site lack alt attributes, making them inaccessible to screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add descriptive alt text to all images. Use alt='' for decorative images.

findings.title: Insufficient color contrast
findings.description: 23 text elements have contrast ratio below 4.5:1 (WCAG AA minimum).
findings.recommendation: Increase text contrast to meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text).

findings.title: Keyboard navigation trap in modal
findings.description: Focus cannot be moved out of the modal dialog using keyboard alone.
findings.recommendation: Implement focus trapping with Escape key support and visible close button.

findings.title: Slow server response time (TTFB)
findings.description: Time to First Byte exceeds 2 seconds on 12 pages. Average TTFB: 3.2s.
findings.recommendation: Optimize server-side rendering, implement caching, use a CDN, and reduce database query complexity.

findings.title: Unoptimized images
findings.description: 8 images are served in PNG format where WebP would reduce size by 40-60%. Total浪费: ~2.4MB.
findings.recommendation: Convert images to WebP/AVIF format. Implement responsive images with srcset.

findings.title: Render-blocking JavaScript
findings.description: 5 synchronous scripts block page rendering until fully downloaded and executed.
findings.recommendation: Add async or defer attributes to non-critical scripts. Inline critical CSS.

findings.title: Missing meta descriptions
findings.description: 10 pages lack meta descriptions, reducing search snippet quality.
findings.recommendation: Add unique, compelling meta descriptions (120-160 characters) to all pages.

findings.title: Missing robots.txt
findings.description: No robots.txt file found at domain root.
findings.recommendation: Create a robots.txt file to guide search engine crawlers.

findings.title: Missing structured data
findings.description: No JSON-LD or Schema.org structured data found on any page.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON-LD structured data for Organization, WebSite, and BreadcrumbList schemas.

findings.title: Deprecated HTML elements
findings.recommendation: Replace deprecated elements with semantic HTML and CSS.

findings.title: Missing viewport meta tag on 2 pages
findings.description: 2 pages lack the viewport meta tag, causing poor mobile rendering.
findings.recommendation: Add <meta name='viewport' content='width=device-width, initial-scale=1'> to all pages.

findings.title: Console errors in production
findings.description: 3 JavaScript errors logged to browser console on the homepage.
findings.recommendation: Fix JavaScript errors and implement error monitoring.
